svg.title: The System One frontier on System1-Arena
svg.desc: Scatter of accuracy versus median latency for all 22 System-1 models and open LLMs in System1-Arena Table 1. Zero-shot answer-token readouts of open LLMs are the fastest accurate models but have worse Brier scores than the best System-1 models; CLM is the fastest System-1-native model and the least accurate.
